 Nebraska Cornhuskers Nebraska dropped its fourth consecutive game on Friday night and, no surprise, the polls and rankings reacted accordingly.
--> Nebraska dropped its fourth consecutive game on Friday night and, no surprise, the polls and rankings reacted accordingly.
 For the Huskers, who need to win one of their final three games to become bowl eligible, this season of great promise and expectations after a 5-0 start has come down to beating either Rutgers, Ohio State or Iowa.
--> For the Huskers, who need to win one of their final three games to become bowl eligible, this season of great promise and expectations after a 5-0 start has come down to beating either Rutgers, Ohio State or Iowa.
 Nebraska lost at Illinois on Friday, 24-13. Huskers offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen was fired the next day. Nebraska’s previous three losses were one-score affairs and in each game, the Huskers led in the fourth quarter .
--> Nebraska lost at Illinois on Friday, 24-13. Huskers offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen was fired the next day. Nebraska’s previous three losses were one-score affairs and in each game, the Huskers led in the fourth quarter .
 Losing such heartbreakers can take an emotional toll on the coaches, players and fans, but so can an 11-point loss at Illinois — a game the Huskers realistically expected to win. With a win against the Illini, the Huskers still had a chance for a respectable season by winning out. We suppose with three consecutive wins to end the season, that still can happen for Nebraska, but have the Huskers shown enough to make anyone think three more wins will happen?

 Nebraska (5-4, 2-4 Big Ten) lost ground in six of the ratings we monitor. The Huskers were thumped by The Athletic, dropping 10 places from 42 to 52.
